title: Self-Care for Asthma-Using Your Inhaler | Asthma | CDC
content: January 25, 2024 Self-Care for Asthma-Using Your Inhaler Key points You can control your asthma by taking your medicine exactly as your doctor or other medical professional tells you to. Use these videos to learn the correct way to use your metered dose inhaler. Taking immediate action Watch a video to follow along with the correct way to use your metered dose inhaler.
